card.name: Dictionary source names before next entry
card.fires_on: The space or word right after a dictionary source credit, such as Century Dictionary and Cyclopedia or American Heritage Dictionary, just before the next '- n.' entry. Also fires on 'of' or 'yclopedia' inside dictionary titles.

modes.label: Gap after source credit
modes.description: The blank space between a dictionary source name and the next definition entry starting with '- n.'.
modes.example: Century Dictionary and Cyclopedia<< >>- n. A carnivorous mammal

modes.label: Inside dictionary titles
modes.description: Words inside a reference work title, like 'of' in 'Dictionary of Phrase and Fable' or the end of 'Cyclopedia'.
modes.example: Source: Dictionary<< of>> Phrase and Fable, E. Cob

card.plain: It marks the point where a dictionary source is named and a new word definition is about to begin.
